needed.evidence: The footway is an informal path blocked by market stalls and goods.
needed.suggestion: Construct a dedicated, wide sidewalk on the right side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic and market stalls.

needed.evidence: Market stalls and produce carts completely block the pedestrian area.
needed.suggestion: Relocate market stalls to a designated vending area to clear the pedestrian path.

needed.evidence: Uneven ground and debris around the market stalls.
needed.suggestion: Level and pave the right-side pedestrian area to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: High pedestrian demand due to shops on both sides, but no designated crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked zebra crossing to provide a safe point for pedestrians to cross the street.

needed.evidence: No street lights are visible along this urban commercial street.
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety at night.
